issuer: the Massachusetts Registry of Motor Vehicles (RMV)
note: Mass.gov (read 2026-10-30): the renewal page says most passenger (Class D) licences are good for 5 years and cost $50; the RMV schedule of fees gives the Mass ID at $5 a year when issued for less than five years, and the licence at $10 a year, the Mass ID for 5 years being $25 (the schedule's table line, in dot leaders, isn't quoted; $5 a year times five is). The Driver's Manual calls the licence of a driver under 18 a Junior Operator licence, so a full Class D is held from 18. Not held: the learner's permit and road test fees, the $115 Class D conversion fee for some transfers.
